name: LLM Models
description: Discover LLM providers and current model choices on this venue, with CALLER-RELATIVE readiness. Returns {providers: [{op, provider, keySecret?, ready, defaultModel, models, recommendations?, url?, note?}]}. Hosted readiness means YOUR secret store or the venue environment supplies the conventional key (never returned); Ollama readiness is live reachability. Hosted lists are supported release-time selections, replaceable via adapters.langchain.models.<provider>.

provider.description: Optional filter: openai | anthropic | gemini | deepseek | xai | ollama

output.description: {providers: [{op, provider, keySecret?, ready, defaultModel, models, recommendations?, url?, note?}]} — choose a ready provider and a model suited to the workload; configure agents with llmOperation = op and model = the selected id.
